[BREAKING] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Riverview woman charged with murder in fatal fentanyl overdose investigation: HCSO
item.description: A Riverview woman is facing a first-degree murder charge after investigators accused her of distributing fentanyl and carfentanil linked to a deadly overdose in Lithia, according to the Hillsborough County Sheriff’s Office.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Lithia drug overdose investigation leads to first-degree murder arrest
item.description: An accused drug dealer is behind bars on a first-degree murder charge after Hillsborough deputies said she gave a deadly dose of fentanyl and carfentanil to a woman who overdosed last year.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Hillsborough juvenile detention center set to close at end of August
item.description: The Florida Department of Juvenile Justice says the Hillsborough Regional Juvenile Detention Center will close at the end of August.
